content:
Apple announced today that it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13), with the theme "Welcome home".

Apple will launch new Home products on October 13, first teased by Greg Joswiak

Apple will unveil multiple new products next Tuesday (October 13), as previewed in a video released by Greg Joswiak. Below is the clip from Joswiak, Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing.

Apple is expected to launch several new Home products at the event, including:

In addition, accessories from the previously leaked LG collaboration — reportedly co-developed with Apple — may also appear next week.

Alongside Joswiak's date reveal, media invitations have gone out, inviting journalists to a special "Apple Experience" event at 9 a.m. Eastern Time in Tribeca, New York.

Below is the invitation as shown by Marques Brownlee:

Top comment from Cuban Missiles

"Welcome home" basically confirms it — Apple is getting into real estate.

Earlier this year, when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it held a similar "Apple Experience" event for the press. At that time, products were rolled out via press releases over several days before the official unveiling.

However, all the new Home products are now expected to debut on the same day.

It is not yet clear whether Apple will simultaneously release a full video introducing the new products at 9 a.m. Eastern Time — we will keep following the latest updates.

Which Apple product are you most looking forward to seeing on October 13? Share your thoughts in the comments.
